stem_book: 15 g mole of H₂ react with 5.2 g mole of I₂ to form 10 g mole of HI at equilibrium [H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g)]. Calculate equilibrium constant for the reaction.
reason: Added 'at equilibrium' and the reaction, both implied by the print; Δn = 0 so volume not needed.
work: 5 mol each consumed → H₂ 10, I₂ 0.2, HI 10 → K = 10²/(10×0.2) = 50
